Net margin is net income divided by total revenues for the quarter.

The question doesn't say whether to use net income or net income attributable to Disney. I used net income attributable to Disney, which is the more common basis.

- Net income attributable to Disney: $2,638 million
- Total revenues: $25,248 million
- Net margin: 2,638 / 25,248 = 10.449%, or about 10.45%

On total net income of $2,844 million, the margin would be 11.26%.

**Net margin ≈ 10.45%**
